description: UCI row 15 (age 32, MEDIUM vulnerability, none knowledge, RT 4) — leveraged etf 3x: hard fails ['R1', 'R4', 'R7'] -> UNSUITABLE
client_narrative: Lieselotte Braun is 32 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 24,000 euros (around 2,000 euros per month). They hold 11,500 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 1,600 euros with a 2-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has no investment experience and has never purchased any financial product beyond basic bank savings accounts. Their investment approach is moderate-to-conservative — they rate their risk tolerance at 4 out of 10. They have stated they cannot afford to lose the full 1,600 euros invested. Their financial circumstances place them in the medium vulnerability category.
product_narrative: The product is a leveraged exchange-traded product providing 3x daily leveraged exposure to the S&P 500 index through financial derivatives and daily rebalancing. Due to compounding effects, returns over periods beyond one day can diverge significantly from three times the index return, and total loss of invested capital is possible in adverse market conditions. The product is classified COMPLEX under MiFID II and requires advanced investor knowledge. It is designed as a short-term speculative instrument; the minimum recommended holding period is one year.
